$comment: Cyber Safety Lab messages. lines are shown in order; flags = indexes of lines that are red flags (tap them in Advanced). level: entry | advanced | both.

lines: 🎉 CONGRATS! You won a FREE gaming laptop!
Claim in 10 MINUTES or it goes to someone else!
Tap here: fr33-prizes.win/claim
Just enter your parent's card number for shipping.
messages.why: Surprise prizes, countdown pressure, a weird link and asking for card numbers are all scam signs.

lines: Your monthly statement is ready.
Log in at fincitybank.com by typing it yourself to view it.
We will never ask for your PIN or password by email.
messages.why: It doesn't ask for anything secret, uses the real domain and tells you to type the address yourself.

lines: URGENT: Your account will be CLOSED today!
Verify now: http://fincity-bank-verify.co/login
Confirm your username, password and PIN to keep access.
messages.why: Look-alike domain (fincity-bank-verify.co), urgent threats, and asking for your password and PIN.

lines: hey want 10,000 free coins??
just send me your login so i can add them
dont tell ur parents its a secret ok
messages.why: Free stuff for your login, plus 'keep it secret', a classic account-stealing trick.

lines: Don't forget your library books are due today! 📚
Love you!
messages.why: A normal message from someone you know, asking for nothing.

lines: You are owed a $1,284.00 tax refund.
To receive it, pay a $49.99 processing fee with a gift card.
Reply with the gift card code within 24 hours.
messages.why: Tax agencies never charge fees for refunds or ask for gift cards. The domain isn't official either.

lines: 🔒 Secure checkout · orbit-outfitters.com
Order total: $54.20 (incl. tax)
Pay with card or FinPay
messages.why: The real store's domain, a normal price and normal payment options. (Still check the URL carefully!)

lines: MOON SNEAKERS 90% OFF, TODAY ONLY
Payment: crypto or wire transfer only
messages.why: The 0 in '0utfitters', impossible discounts and untraceable payment methods signal a fake store.

lines: We'd love to hire you as a remote 'payment processor' for $900/week!
We'll send you checks; deposit them and wire back 80%.
Keep 20% as your pay.
messages.why: A fake-check scam: the checks bounce later and you owe the bank everything you wired.

lines: Fin City Delivery: your package is held.
Pay $1.99 redelivery fee: fcdeliv.ry/pay
messages.why: Small 'fee' texts with odd short links are used to steal card numbers ('smishing').

lines: Your daily challenge is ready! Play to earn tickets.
messages.why: An official app notification that doesn't ask for any information.

lines: Hi it's your cousin! I lost my phone, this is my new number.
Can you buy me a $100 gift card and text me the code? I'll pay you back!
messages.why: Impersonating family plus gift-card codes = scam. Call the real person on a number you already know.

lines: A new sign-in to your account from a new device.
If this was you, no action needed.
If not, open the CloudKite app to secure your account.
messages.why: Real security alerts tell you to use the app or type the site yourself; this one asks for nothing.

lines: Guaranteed 100× returns in 30 days!
Celebrities are buying, don't miss out!
Minimum investment $500. Refer friends for bonuses.
messages.why: Guaranteed huge returns, celebrity hype and referral rewards are signs of a Ponzi or pump-and-dump.

lines: gg! that was a fun race 😀
messages.why: Just a friendly message, it doesn't ask for anything.

lines: You won a pony!!! 🐴
Send your home address and your mom's credit card to get it.
messages.why: Nobody gives away ponies by text! Never share addresses or card numbers.
